# Identifier Retrieval Examples

## Error Code

`AUTH_CACHE_MISS_2047` means the local authorization cache had no matching entry. Search exact error codes with grep_wiki before broader concept retrieval.

## Function Name

The example function `updateCustomerProfileCache` refreshes a sanitized profile cache after a successful local write.

## Class Name

The sample class `com.example.knowledge.LocalWikiIndexService` owns index loading and freshness checks in the fictional reference project.

## File Path

The example configuration path is `packages/desktop/config/local-wiki.settings.json`. Path terms and filename extensions receive lexical coverage.

## Environment Variable

`LOCAL_WIKI_STRICT_REFRESH=1` is a fictional flag used only by this test corpus to demonstrate exact environment-variable retrieval.
